sources.entry: Kill Bill - Subscription billing & payments platform. Have access to real-time analytics and financial reports. (Source Code) Apache-2.0 Java/Docker

summary.one_liner: Kill Bill is an open-source, self-hosted subscription billing and payments platform (Java, Docker) covering catalogs, subscriptions, invoicing, gateway payments, tax and dunning.
summary.what_it_does: Kill Bill handles product catalogs and pricing, subscription lifecycles, usage metering, invoicing, payments across gateways, credits, tax, and dunning (retry/collection of failed payments). It is designed to run on your own infrastructure, on premises or in the cloud. It is highly modular, so individual functions can be disabled or replaced with existing systems. Plugins connect payment gateways and tax engines without forking the core. The README also describes it as scaling with business growth and allowing trials and promotional discounts. Technical docs, REST API docs, and a getting started guide are linked from the README.
use_cases: connecting payment gateways and tax engines
how_to_run: See the getting started guide linked from killbill.io to run Kill Bill locally
Technical documentation is at docs.killbill.io; sources are in the killbill/killbill-docs repository
REST API reference is at apidocs.killbill.io
notable: In production since 2010, per the README
Modular design: disable or replace individual functions
Plugin system for payment gateways and tax engines without forking the core
Apache License 2.0 with optional Aviate enterprise edition
caveats: No support or SLA in the free open-source version; community help via mailing list and GitHub issues
Enterprise features and Level 3 support are part of the paid Aviate offer under a commercial license
Not an all-in-one solution; integration with other systems is expected
keywords: run billing on my own servers
